availability: Dr. Helfrich stated that only this Mac is available; participants and a physical Windows desktop are unavailable.
research_case: Public Engel food-expenditure reference, linear/quadratic OLS with HC3; reference estimates are not population truth.
research_tasks: State the target and distinguish known simulator truth from the unknown target in observed Engel data.
Estimate the linear and quadratic Engel specifications and inspect HC3 intervals.
Save, reopen and reproduce the selected analysis from its export.
Specify and run a confounding simulation with explicit method variants and a fit allowance.
Cancel/resume, inspect an actual replication, and explain failure and coverage denominators.
instructor_tasks: Choose a template and target, and record a prediction before showing results.
Explain the actual sampling distribution, interval plot and Monte Carlo uncertainty.
Regenerate a selected replication and connect coefficients to its observations.
Use the transfer exercise after changing a generating assumption.
Export a student packet and verify that it excludes the oracle, seed, truth and key.
learner_tasks: Record a prediction and its reasoning before result disclosure.
Explain what changed and what remained fixed after altering an assumption.
Distinguish coefficient SE, Monte Carlo SE, coverage and causal identification.
Answer a transfer question using a different parameter setting.
limits: No participants, consent, completed tasks or observed teaching sessions are asserted by this protocol.
Small pilot outcomes are descriptive usability/feasibility evidence, not learning superiority.
Dr. Helfrich owns any future recruitment; no automatic outreach is authorized.
Keep identifying responses and private participant notes local and outside the generic reuse catalogue.
